blocking_findings.finding: The real zero-page hook contract can never reach the empty state. usePdfDocument sets firstPageReady to numPages > 0, while PdfViewer requires firstPageReady && numPages === 0 for pdf-state-empty; a genuine zero-page document therefore remains on LOADING indefinitely. The DOM test hides this integration defect by supplying the impossible combination firstPageReady=true,numPages=0.
blocking_findings.required_fix: Derive empty from status === "ready" && numPages === 0, make loading/progressive predicates compatible with the real hook result, and add an integration-shaped test using the actual zero-page hook semantics.

blocking_findings.finding: Controlled toolbar boundary semantics are incomplete. Numeric 0 is rejected and reverted instead of clamped to page 1, despite the contract requiring committed numeric values to clamp to 1..N. Zoom-out/zoom-in buttons also remain enabled at MIN_ZOOM/MAX_ZOOM. The focused test explicitly codifies the incorrect 0 behavior and does not test zoom boundary disables.
blocking_findings.required_fix: Treat every digits-only finite value, including 0, as numeric and clamp it to 1..numPages; continue reverting only empty/non-numeric input. Disable zoom-out at MIN_ZOOM and zoom-in at MAX_ZOOM, preserve keyboard preventDefault only for actual changes, and add exact lower/upper-bound tests.

blocking_findings.finding: All loading/error/empty presentations use rounded, bordered, tinted state-card chrome inside the recessed viewer well. This violates task .4's explicit Scholarly Dusk requirement of no visual Card/bordered rounded state-card chrome inside the well; avoiding the Card import alone does not satisfy it.
blocking_findings.required_fix: Render the canonical eyebrow/body/actions as a flat semantic state treatment within the well, removing the rounded border/background state-card container while retaining exact copy, hooks, roles, focus treatment, and actions.

blocking_findings.finding: PdfViewer's production-exported prop contract includes usePdfDocumentImpl and usePdfPagesImpl test injection seams, although the approved exact component contract contains only assetUrl, downloadUrl, extractedTextAvailable, and onFallback. These seams let callers replace core generation/cancellation integration, and the tests consequently verify stubs rather than the real task .3 composition—contributing directly to the missed zero-page defect.
blocking_findings.required_fix: Restore the exact four-prop production contract. Move dependency substitution behind a test-only module boundary/harness or test the real hooks with their existing lower-level dependency seams, including real gen/cancel and zero-page integration.

non_blocking_observations: The responsive test contains `querySelector(...) || fitWidth.innerHTML`, so it succeeds whenever the button has any markup and does not prove the expected responsive label structure. It also checks only class strings, not the promised two-row <lg layout.

Focused component tests pass 35/35, but their stubs make several integration assertions vacuous. Progressive rendering, exact copy, fallback directions, custom fit state, reduced-motion scrolling, no duplicate view toggle, and download-anchor shape otherwise matched the inspected contracts.

The prerequisite regression command reported 63 pass and 6 failures, and test:web reported 255 pass and 1 failure. Every failure was caused by sandbox-only EROFS while creating /tmp fixtures; no product assertion failed before those setup errors.
No reviewer files were modified. The pre-existing dirty worktree was preserved.
